verdicts.reason: Both are the same broken layout. The food photos have shrunk to tiny thumbnails sitting in background tiles. The orange frame and the plate illustration are scattered across the canvas as empty fragments. The frame is torn into separate pieces and the headline is cut off from the rest. A is marginally less bad because 'Cascadia RESTAURANT' stays together as a lockup, while B splits 'Cascadia' and 'RESTAURANT' far apart and breaks the brand mark.
